prompt: Briefly  explain what the popular open source tool crowdsec is
response: CrowdSec is an open-source security tool that provides real-time protection against various security threats. It works by analyzing system logs and detecting potential security incidents, then taking automated actions to mitigate those threats. CrowdSec can be used to protect web applications, servers, and other systems from attacks such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and brute force attacks. It is designed to be easy to use and can be deployed on-premises or in the cloud.
